literal_meaning: ম্যাও (বিড়ালের ডাক শব্দ) ধরা বা ধারণ করা
similar_in_english: take the bull by the horns
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পের ম্যাও ধরতে হবে কাউকে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has taken up the family responsibilities.
Someone has to step up and take the meow for this project.
note: This idiom may derive from the idea of catching or responding to a cat's meow, symbolizing taking on an unexpected or elusive duty in rural Bengali contexts.
